question: Is the dominant is-was writer bypass carried through the block-10 residual identity path, through the distributed outputs of blocks 10--17, or through their interaction?

factorial.R0M0: Native block-10 input residual and native downstream module outputs; the native reference.
factorial.R1M0: Writer-run block-10 input residual installed through the is-was query while all A10--M17 outputs are clamped to native-run tensors; isolates the residual/identity carrier under controlled native responses.
factorial.R0M1: Native block-10 input residual while all A10--M17 outputs are clamped to writer-run tensors; isolates the distributed downstream module-response carrier.
factorial.R1M1: Writer-run block-10 input residual plus all writer-run downstream module outputs; must replay the complete selected-writer effect.

scope: Original FIT and HOLDOUT pooled panels. OOD is reserved for the promoted branch after the causal carrier is identified.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_writer_replay_s: All authorities, selected writer/source/query maps, block-10 state and 16 module captures, hook counts, writer replay, finite metrics, and literal price pass.
predictions.pred_b_joint_state_and_module_clamp_repl: R1M1 passes every joint writer-replay bar on FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_c_residual_identity_path_is_a_major: R1M0 passes every dominant-carrier bar on FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_d_distributed_module_response_is_a_: R0M1 passes every dominant-carrier bar on FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_e_two_factor_decomposition_is_addit: The relative L2 error between R1M1 and R1M0+R0M1 is <=0.25 on FIT/HOLDOUT and every nonnative arm's temporal-command effect is <=0.01 of temporal gold.

decision.identity_skip_dominant: C true, D false: identify the block-10 residual identity carrier; next translate its query-position tensor through exact suffix normalization/unembedding weights and selectively remove it.
decision.module_response_dominant: C false, D true: use the queued cumulative module result to select and split the response path into heads/MLPs.
decision.redundant_dual_carriers: C and D true: treat residual and module response as redundant causal carriers and test removals/composition.
decision.interaction_dominant: B true but C and D false: the bypass requires state-response interaction; retain the full 2x2 term and test its OOD stability rather than forcing additive modules.
decision.invalid: A or B false: do not interpret C--E.

prior_art_lesson: The older v15 all-layer atlas showed that complete input-state sufficiency can be tautological. This experiment therefore does not claim R1 state sufficiency alone: it clamps native versus writer module responses in a registered 2x2 and requires exact R1M1 replay plus explicit interaction accounting.
anti_rank_drift: No fitted subspace, DAS, rank, reconstruction, variance, or compression objective is used.
